_comment: Games made by the person behind Bloxwire. Every promo shows a disclosure. Set status to "live" and fill in url once a game is published on Roblox. cover = brick motifs from src/covers.mjs (main first).

trick-or-scream.name: Trick or Scream
trick-or-scream.pitch: Ring doorbells, collect candy and try not to scream: ghosts and monsters can scare the candy right out of your bag. Unlock costumes, explore creepier neighborhoods and build your own haunted house.

brainrot-fusion-rush.name: Brainrot Fusion Rush
brainrot-fusion-rush.pitch: Collect brainrots, steal them from other bases and throw them into the Fusion Machine to create something new. Then survive the Blackout event.

gem-rush.name: Gem Rush
gem-rush.pitch: A pet game across multiple dimensions: your pets fight hostile mobs and mine gems while you push deeper into stranger worlds.
